WITH book AS (
  SELECT bids, asks FROM market_data
  WHERE symbol = @symbol AND timestamp >= dateadd('m', -10, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
), m AS (
  SELECT (bids[1][1] + asks[1][1]) / 2 AS mid,
         CASE WHEN @symbol LIKE '%JPY' THEN 0.01 WHEN @symbol = 'XAGUSD' THEN 0.001 WHEN @symbol LIKE 'X%' THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.0001 END AS pip
  FROM book
)
SELECT round((u.price - m.mid) / m.pip, 1) AS pips_from_mid, u.depth AS bid_depth, NULL::double AS ask_depth
FROM book b CROSS JOIN m, UNNEST(b.bids[1], array_cum_sum(b.bids[2])) u(price, depth)
UNION ALL
SELECT round((u.price - m.mid) / m.pip, 1), NULL::double, u.depth
FROM book b CROSS JOIN m, UNNEST(b.asks[1], array_cum_sum(b.asks[2])) u(price, depth)
ORDER BY pips_from_mid
cells.name: Market Depth (pips from mid)

SELECT to_str(ts, 'HH:mm:ss') AS Time, cast(round(spread, 5) AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS Spread,
       round(bid_volume)::long AS Bid_Volume, round(ask_volume)::long AS Ask_Volume
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS ts, avg(asks[1,1] - bids[1,1]) AS spread, sum(bids[1,1] * bids[2,1]) AS bid_volume, sum(asks[1,1] * asks[2,1]) AS ask_volume
  FROM market_data
  WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('s', -65, @asof) AND timestamp <= dateadd('s', -5, @asof) AND symbol = @symbol
  SAMPLE BY 1s
  ORDER BY ts DESC
  LIMIT 6
)
cells.name: Spread and Volume per second

WITH p AS (
  SELECT timestamp, bid_price, bid_volume, symbol, ecn FROM core_price
  WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -1, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
  LIMIT -6
), levels AS (
  SELECT market_data.timestamp AS md_timestamp,
         insertion_point(bids[2], bid_volume) AS level,
         bids[1][insertion_point(bids[2], bid_volume)] AS price,
         bids[2][insertion_point(bids[2], bid_volume)] AS volume,
         p.timestamp, p.bid_price, p.bid_volume AS bid_volume, p.ecn
  FROM p ASOF JOIN market_data ON symbol
)
SELECT to_str(md_timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.SSS') AS MarketData_Time, CASE WHEN price IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE level END AS Level, price AS Price, volume::long AS Volume,
       to_str(timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.SSS') AS CorePrice_Time, bid_price AS Bid_Price, bid_volume1 AS Bid_Volume, ecn AS ECN
FROM levels
cells.name: Top-of-book Price vs Core Price

SELECT timestamp, first(bids[1,1]) AS open, max(bids[1,1]) AS high, min(bids[1,1]) AS low, last(bids[1,1]) AS close
FROM market_data
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -1, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
SAMPLE BY 1s;
SELECT timestamp, sum(bids[2,1]) AS total_volume
FROM market_data
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -1, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
SAMPLE BY 1s
cells.name: OHLC - Bids - 1m

SELECT timestamp, open, high, low, close
FROM market_data_ohlc_15m
WHERE timestamp >= timestamp_floor('d', @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol;
WITH sampled AS (
  SELECT timestamp, symbol, total_volume, ((open + close) / 2) * total_volume AS traded_value
  FROM market_data_ohlc_1m
  WHERE timestamp >= timestamp_floor('d', @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
), cumulative AS (
  SELECT timestamp,
    sum(traded_value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS cumulative_value,
    sum(total_volume) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS cumulative_volume
  FROM sampled
)
SELECT timestamp, cumulative_value / cumulative_volume AS vwap FROM cumulative;
WITH price_changes AS (
  SELECT timestamp, symbol, bid, bid - prev_bid AS price_change
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, symbol, bid, lag(bid) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_bid
    FROM bbo_1h
    WHERE timestamp >= timestamp_floor('d', @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
  )
),
gains_losses AS (
  SELECT timestamp, symbol, bid,
    CASE WHEN price_change > 0 THEN price_change ELSE 0 END AS gain,
    CASE WHEN price_change < 0 THEN abs(price_change) ELSE 0 END AS loss
  FROM price_changes
),
avg_gains_losses AS (
  SELECT timestamp, symbol, bid,
    avg(gain) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_gain,
    avg(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_loss
  FROM gains_losses
)
SELECT timestamp,
  CASE WHEN avg_loss = 0 THEN 100 ELSE 100 - (100 / (1 + (avg_gain / NULLIF(avg_loss, 0)))) END AS rsi_12h
FROM avg_gains_losses
ORDER BY timestamp;
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT timestamp, close,
    avg(close) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sma20,
    avg(close * close) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_close_sq
  FROM market_data_ohlc_15m
  WHERE timestamp >= timestamp_floor('d', @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
)
SELECT timestamp, sma20,
  sma20 + 2 * sqrt(avg_close_sq - (sma20 * sma20)) AS upper_band,
  sma20 - 2 * sqrt(avg_close_sq - (sma20 * sma20)) AS lower_band
FROM stats ORDER BY timestamp
cells.name: VWAP - Relative Strength Index 12h - Bollinger Bands (20,2)

SELECT timestamp, bid, ask, (bid + ask) / 2 AS mid
FROM bbo_1s
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -30, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol;
SELECT timestamp, sum(bids[1,1] * bids[2,1]) AS bid_volume, -1 * sum(asks[1,1] * asks[2,1]) AS ask_volume
FROM market_data
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -30, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
SAMPLE BY 30s
cells.name: Bid vs Ask Volume (30s) - BBO (1s)
